_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro: Dangaa di xeex Klondike Solitaire. Sa bëre mooy nga dugal bépp kaar-dëkk ci ndab yi ñu tëral. Jëf yu jëfandikoo: - Ndab yi ñuy tànne (F1-F4): Yékkati sa bopp ba ca Ace, jëm King bu ànd ak suit bi; Tableau piles (T1-T7): Yekkati say tur yu wuute (maroom ci weñ, sew ci suux) - Stock: Dajale ay kaarte ngir yàq pile gi; Waste (W): Kaart mu kawe mi nekk fi kanam ji ngay jokkoo Koondig "déggal" - Dajale xar-dëkki yii jóge stock dem waste - 'defar <source><destination> [count]' - Defal ay kaarts diggante pilaay yi Example: 'mooy W T1', 'doxal T1 F2', 'dooxe T3 T5 2'. Man na it a lim "all", muy jéem a yeggël lépp li am solo ciy kaart yu jàll si yoon wi. - Doole ko - Jeexal game bi te jàpp ne man ngaa soppalu leen yépp ci seeni turu teytuwaayam - Pilew gu jamonoy w-.

format_error.no_brackets: Jëfandikoo jëf ju amul solo. Doole na nekk ci ay kuréel.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Jëfandikoo jëf ju amul solo. "]" buñ tënk ci lañuy jeexal
format_error.empty_command: Njiital bu amul benn baat. Jëfandikoo "draw" walla "move <source> <destination> [count]".
format_error.move_needs_args: Njiitu jëmale soxla na fu mu jóge ak fa muy jëm. Jëfandikoo: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Jëfandikoo nañ ko ci "all" walla lu am solo.
format_error.count_invalid: Jëfandikoo lim bu amul solo walla " ñépp ".

action_result.before_failure: Jëfandikoo na {n} jëf ((s) laata mu ñàkk.

move_result.drew: Drew card(s) from stock to waste.
move_result.cannot_draw: Mënuñu ko jël, te lépp a leer.
move_result.invalid_pile: Tur wu amul solo. Jëfandikoo W, F1-F4, walla T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: Man na dawal benn kaar-dëkk rekk ci fondasiyoŋ bi.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Carte bi ñu génne ci sànku yi, yóbbu ko ca fondasiyoŋ ba F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Manul a dugal ab kaar-dëgg ci suufu fondation bi. 🔍
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Moved card from tableau T{src} to foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Manul a dugal xar-kanamu tablo bi ci suufu fondation boobu. 🔍
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Du mën a dem ci fondation ba fondation.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Man na dawal benn kaar-dëgg rekk ci wàllug rëdd ak tablo bi.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Manul a teg ab kaar-dëgg ci ndab li.
move_result.no_face_up: Duñ mën a yékkati ay kaar-dëkk.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Moved {count} card(s) from tableau T{src} to T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Cannot move {count} card(s) from T{src} to T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Man na dawal benn kaar-dëgg rekk ci fondation bi ba tableau bi.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Moved card from foundation F{src} to tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Manul a teg kaarange bu ñu sos ci table T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Du mën a dem ci wàllug mbëj mbaa denc.

outcome.forfeit: Game forfeited. Final score: {score} cards in foundations.
outcome.won: Ngir dimbali leen, ngeen jël Klondike Solitaire!
